response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS AvgBytesPerMs FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) AS OverallAvg FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.AvgBytesPerMs, p.AvgBytesPerMs - o.OverallAvg AS AboveOverall FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.AvgBytesPerMs > o.OverallAvg ORDER BY p.AvgBytesPerMs DESC;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff is inclusive: tracks with Bytes >= 10,323,804 qualify. The request says 'pass a cutoff' without saying whether equal values count.

The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type averages, computed only over media types that have at least one qualifying track. Tracks with Milliseconds = 0 are excluded from the per-track ratio via NULLIF, so no division by zero occurs.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is exclusive: only tracks with Bytes strictly greater than 10,323,804 qualify.
